record.question: The politician and the philanthropist _______ invited to speak.
record.explanation: The source repeats the definite article: the politician and the philanthropist. On the ordinary reading these are two people, giving a plural compound subject. Were is the only offered plural verb and yields were invited to speak. The one-person double-role reading used in Luna's explanation belongs to different wording with a shared article; it does not establish a material ambiguity in this printed agreement question. Reviewed solution (unofficial). References: https://our-languages.canada.ca/en/writing-tips-plus/verb-agreement-compound-subjects-with-and
